_doc: Reward penalty weights and curriculum gates for sim/streetball (read by sim/streetball/reward_config.py). Mirrored by the Unreal DataAsset UStreetballRewardConfig (unreal/StreetballGym/Source/StreetballGym/StreetballRewardConfig.h); keep both equal (sim/tests/test_reward_config.py). Weights are added to the reward as weight * term, so penalties are negative. foot_slip was added on 2026-11-20 and power_abs, com_offset, com_vel_z_sq, ang_vel_xy_sq, short_swing on 2026-11-24 (weight 0 = off): the shipped policies in shared/policies were trained before them and were NOT retrained.

terms.joint_ang_vel_sq: mean over hinge joints of qvel^2 (rad/s)^2
terms.foot_slip: sum over feet of contact * planar foot speed^2 (m/s)^2
terms.com_offset: |CoM_xy - support centre_xy|^2 (m^2); support centre = mean of the foot corner sites of feet in contact (all corners when airborne)
terms.com_vel_z_sq: vertical CoM speed^2 (m/s)^2, finite difference between control steps
terms.ang_vel_xy_sq: pelvis roll and pitch rate^2, pelvis frame (rad/s)^2
terms.short_swing: sum over feet, at touchdown, of max(0, 0.35 s - swing time) (s)
